tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.2 Time-based Media - 1.2.6 Sign Language (Prerecorded)
tests.description: Guideline 1.2  Provide alternatives for time-based media. Success Criteria:    1.2.6 Sign Language (Prerecorded) General Objective: To verify that pre-recorded video content with audio provides extended audio descriptions when necessary to understand the content. This test case verifies whether a pre-recorded video on the web site provides extended audio descriptions at times necessary to understand the content. Extended audio descriptions provide information about actions, characters, scenes, and on-screen information that cannot be understood from the original audio of the pre-recorded video alone. Expected Result: The pre-recorded video with audio provides extended audio descriptions at times necessary to understand the content. The extended audio descriptions can be activated and provide additional information that is not available in the original audio of the video.

steps.action: Identify prerecorded audio content (videos with narration or dialogue)
steps.result: Videos must include sign language interpretation visible on screen or activatable

steps.action: Verify visibility and size of sign language interpreter
steps.result: Interpreter must be clearly visible, with adequate contrast and sufficient size to distinguish signs

steps.action: Verify synchronization between audio and sign language
steps.result: Sign interpretation must be synchronized with spoken audio without significant delays

steps.action: Identify videos where natural pauses are insufficient for audio description
steps.result: Video must automatically pause to allow extended audio description of complex visual information

steps.action: Play video with extended audio description and verify pauses
steps.result: Video must pause when needed to describe visual elements, then continue automatically

steps.action: Verify user control over extended audio description
steps.result: User must be able to enable or disable extended audio description per preference

steps.action: Confirm that extended description does not interfere with content comprehension
steps.result: Pauses and descriptions must integrate naturally without causing confusion or loss of narrative context

steps.result: Site must support simultaneous use of different input mechanisms without restrictions

steps.action: Verify switching input method does not cause loss of functionality

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.5 Input Modalities - 2.5.7 Dragging Movements
tests.description: Guideline 2.5  Make it easier for users to operate functionality through various inputs beyond keyboard. Success Criteria:    2.5.7 Dragging Movements

steps.action: Verify spacing between adjacent touch targets
steps.result: If targets are smaller than 24px, sufficient surrounding space must exist to avoid errors

tests.description: Guideline 3.2  Make Web pages appear and operate in predictable ways. Success Criteria:    3.2.1 On Focus

steps.result: No element should cause context change (navigation, submission) just by receiving focus

steps.action: Verify form fields do not submit when focused
steps.result: Focus must be independent of activation, changes must only occur with explicit action

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.2 Predictable - 3.2.2 On Input

steps.action: Test selects and radios that may cause automatic navigation

steps.action: Compare menus and navigation across different pages
steps.result: Repeated navigation elements must appear in same order across all pages

steps.action: Document location of global elements (search, login, main menu)
steps.result: Common components must maintain consistent position and order throughout site

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.2 Predictable - 3.2.4 Consistent Identification
tests.description: Guideline 3.2  Make Web pages appear and operate in predictable ways. Success Criteria:    3.2.4 Consistent Identification

steps.action: Identify components with same function across different pages
steps.result: Equivalent components must use same labels, icons, and accessible names

steps.action: Verify consistency of icons and symbols throughout site
steps.result: Same icon must represent same function, avoid different symbols for identical actions

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.2 Predictable - 3.2.5 Change on Request
tests.description: Guideline 3.2  Make Web pages appear and operate in predictable ways. Success Criteria:    3.2.5 Change on Request

steps.action: Verify significant changes require explicit user action
steps.result: Context changes, submissions, or navigation must not occur without explicit confirmation

steps.action: Identify and fix automatic submissions or unexpected redirects
steps.result: User must initiate all important changes through clear buttons or links

tests.description: Guideline 3.2 Predictable: Make Web pages appear and operate in predictable ways. Success Criteria: 3.2.6 Consistent Help (A) - If a Web page contains help mechanisms, and those mechanisms are repeated on multiple Web pages within a set of Web pages, they occur in the same relative order to other page content, unless a change is initiated by the user.

steps.action: Verify quick access to contact, FAQ, chat, or documentation
steps.result: Help must be available predictably in fixed location

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.3 Input Assistance - 3.3.5 Help

steps.result: Available help must exist to complete tasks, visible or easily accessible

steps.action: Verify tooltips, help links, or info icons next to complex fields
